title: AirQualityObservations (ObservationCollection)
description: GENERATED from model/airquality.model.yaml - do not edit by hand. Canonical model version 2.1.0-canonical.1, source: observations.xsd (partner schema version 2.1). The root validates a full delivery (ObservationCollection); API resources are available under $defs (e.g. #/$defs/ObservationRecord, #/$defs/StationSummary).

ObservationCollection.description: A delivery from a partner - a batch of stations with their sampling points and observations.

id.description: Document/technical identifier of the station (xs:ID). Treated as the station's stable id.

stationCode.description: Business code of the station (e.g. national/EEA station code).

operator.description: Name of the organisation operating the station (free text).

Position.description: Geographic position of the station. CRS ASSUMED to be WGS84 (EPSG:4326), decimal degrees.

altitude.description: Altitude in metres above mean sea level (unit and datum ASSUMED). Absent and null both mean unknown.

SamplingPoint.description: A measurement configuration at a station for exactly one pollutant. Owns the time series of observations; all observations share the sampling point's unit.

pollutant.description: Pollutant code from the EEA pollutant vocabulary notation (e.g. NO2, PM10, PM2.5, O3, SO2, CO). Not enforced as an enum because the XSD does not list the 6 pollutants in use.

unit.description: Unit of measurement of all observation values (e.g. ug/m3, mg/m3).

Observation.description: One aggregated measurement over the interval [begin, end). Expected cadence is hourly. Natural key within a sampling point: begin.

begin.description: Start of the averaging interval (inclusive - assumed).

end.description: End of the averaging interval (exclusive - assumed). Must be later than begin (not expressible in XSD/JSON Schema; validate in code).

value.description: Measured value in the sampling point's unit; null when no value is available.

StationKind.description: Station classification by dominant emission source (EEA 'station type').

x-enumDescriptions.traffic: Pollution level dominated by emissions from nearby traffic.
x-enumDescriptions.industrial: Pollution level dominated by industrial sources.
x-enumDescriptions.background: Not dominated by a single source; representative of general exposure.

ValidityFlag.description: Observation validity flag. Values ASSUMED to follow the EEA e-Reporting validity vocabulary (http://dd.eionet.europa.eu/vocabulary/aq/observationvalidity); the XSD only says xs:int.

x-enumDescriptions.-99: Not valid due to station maintenance or calibration in progress.

VerificationFlag.description: Observation verification flag. Values ASSUMED to follow the EEA e-Reporting verification vocabulary (http://dd.eionet.europa.eu/vocabulary/aq/observationverification).

ObservationRecord.description: Flat observation as returned by the REST API (e.g. GET /observations?station=..&pollutant=..&from=..&to=..). Denormalises station/sampling point keys onto each observation for efficient paging over ~57,600 rows/day.
